title: Dimensions, kinds and the equations' statements: refused when unsound, exact when not
note: Assurance H (D-2026-177). Each mutation converts across a dimension, a kind or the Celsius scale it must not, loses a prefix, a power, a denominator or an offset, guesses at an unknown symbol, or lets a unit declared wrong pass the statement it enters. tests/test_dimensions.py holds each against the three models' declared units.

mutations.replace:

mutations.rationale: H: 40 degC becomes a number of kelvin without knowing a temperature from a difference

mutations.name: DM2_dimensions_are_not_compared
mutations.find:
if a.dims != b.dims:
        raise DimensionError(f"{frm!r} and {to!r} differ in dimension")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise DimensionError(f"{frm!r} and {to!r} differ in dimension")
mutations.rationale: H: a mass converts to a heat flux

mutations.name: DM3_kinds_are_not_compared
mutations.find: if to_kind is not None and to_kind != kind:
mutations.rationale: H: a heat capacity converts to an entropy because their units agree

mutations.name: DM4_an_absolute_temperature_loses_its_offset
mutations.rationale: H: 40 degC is converted as if it were a difference of 40 K

mutations.name: DM5_a_prefix_scales_nothing
mutations.rationale: H: 1.2 kW is read as 1.2 W

mutations.name: DM6_an_unknown_symbol_is_dimensionless
mutations.find: raise DimensionError(f"no unit {sym!r} is defined here")
mutations.rationale: H: a unit nothing defines is guessed at

mutations.name: DM7_the_denominator_is_not_inverted
mutations.rationale: H: W/K reads as W K, a conductance as a power times a temperature

mutations.name: DM8_a_power_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: H: m^-2 reads as m, an areal density as a length

mutations.name: DM9_a_statement_ignores_its_powers
mutations.find: out = [o + d * Fraction(power) for o, d in zip(out, u.dims)]
mutations.replace: out = [o + d for o, d in zip(out, u.dims)]
mutations.rationale: H: L^2 counts as L in an equation's dimensional statement

mutations.name: DM10_a_broken_statement_is_not_reported
mutations.rationale: H: a unit declared wrong breaks no statement

mutations.name: DM11_shared_dimensions_name_no_other_kind

return sorted(k for k, v in KINDS.items()
